errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart where the vertical axis lists the categories (poem names) and the horizontal axis represents the values. The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis contains the poem names.
The description incorrectly names two of the poems. The chart labels are “江南曲” and “杂诗”, not “江苏曲” and “东野曲”.
The description claims the bars are not clearly arranged, but they are explicitly sorted in descending order of their numerical value from top to bottom.
The description incorrectly states the vertical axis represents the difficulty value. In this horizontal bar chart, the horizontal axis represents the difficulty value.

errors.text_span: 统计数据通过以不同颜色区分的柱状图来表示。柱状图的颜色为蓝、浅蓝、深蓝和灰蓝。
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates that the bars have different colors (blue, light blue, dark blue, and gray-blue). In the figure, all bars are the same single color (light blue).
The description fails to mention a prominent feature of the data: that four of the poems share the exact same difficulty value (11.42285962) and another two poems also share a value (11.35833271).

errors.text_span: 最短的柱状图之一对应“塞下曲四首一”和“问刘十九”
errors.evidence: The description identifies '问刘十九' as 'one of the shortest bars'. While '塞下曲四首一' is the shortest, '问刘十九' is the third shortest, which makes this statement imprecise. The two bars are not equal in length.

errors.text_span: 其余的柱状图高度较为接近，数值大约在11.4到11.5之间。
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. The remaining bars after the top two have values ranging from approximately 11.33 to 11.42. Stating the range is 'between 11.4 and 11.5' is inaccurate as it excludes several bars and is not representative of the actual distribution.
